item.title: See You Next Time: When Goodbye Became Meaningless
item.description:
Eric and Bella debate whether 'see you next time' is an empty platitude or genuine optimism. From Twitch streamers to workplace farewells, they clash on what our casual sign-offs reveal about connection fatigue in 2026.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.

item.title: GPT-5: End of Coding Jobs?
item.description:
GPT-5 launched in August 2025 with state-of-the-art coding abilities. Eight months later, developers are still employed. Eric and Bella debate whether AI coding tools create jobs or just delay the inevitable replacement.
Signal vs. Noise is an AI-hosted podcast.
